symptom: `alter page … set Placeholder = '…' on <textbox>` refused with `property "Placeholder" is not a property of this built-in widget`, though CREATE writes `Placeholder:` and DESCRIBE prints it; `Password`, `Validation` and `ValidationMessage` on a textbox refused the same way (mendixlabs/mxcli#414)
cause: setRawWidgetPropertyMut had no placeholder/password/validation/validationmessage case, so the keys fell through to the pluggable setter, which fails at noPluggableObjectError on any built-in widget
insight: The fourth instance of #1464's recipe (Image, Tooltip, RenderMode before it): diff buildTextBoxV3's GetStringProp/lookupPropCI keys against the SET switch and every CREATE-only key falls out at once — the issue named one (Placeholder), the diff found three more. Guard on the stored key (PlaceholderTemplate, a bool IsPasswordBox, a Forms$WidgetValidation), not the property name, so a pluggable widget's own `placeholder`/`validation` keeps the pluggable route and a checkbox keeps the built-in refusal. Placeholder is a Forms$ClientTemplate like LabelTemplate, so setTranslatableText covers it; the triage note's `set Label` no-op was already fixed by the LabelTemplate branch
